# Compiled state

Every file in this directory is generated from the authored documents in
`prokron/`. Nothing here is authoritative and nothing here should be edited by
hand. Delete the directory and run `prokron compile` to rebuild it.

| --- | --- |
| `project.json` | The whole compiled project, with provenance for every object. |
| `STATE.md` | Where the project stands right now. |
| `TASK_GRAPH.md` | Dependencies, ready work, and blockers. |
| `dashboard.html` | The same state as a browsable page. |
